{{Quote|Command station, this is ST-321, code clearance blue. We are starting our approach. Deactivate the security shield.|Yorr to the Death Star command center|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
'''Yorr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He was a member of several important and influential organizations within the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], such as the specialized [[Emperor's Demonstration Team|Imperial Demonstration Team]], and [[Onyx Squadron/Legends|Onyx Squadron]]. He was also the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[ST 321/Legends|shuttle]] prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The security deflector shield will be deactivated when we have confirmation of your code transmission. Stand by&hellip;''"''<br />''"''Quick as you can, please&mdash;this better not take long. He's in no mood to wait&hellip;|Jad Bean and Yorr regarding allowing Darth Vader's shuttle to land|<ref name="ROTJN">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi novelization'']]</ref>}}
Yorr was a Human male who, at some point before the Battle of Endor, was a member of a specialized group within the Imperial Military known as the Imperial Demonstration Team. He also served as a test pilot on various [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] prototype [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Yorr became a member of a starfighter squadron within in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] known as Onyx Squadron. During his time with Onyx [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], Yorr's call sign was [[Onyx 2]], and he served alongside his wingman, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jendon/Legends|Jendon]]. He had scored at least twenty-four combat victories while he was still part of Onyx squadron.<ref name="CCG" /> Because of the devastating blow to the Empire and major loss of personnel in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Yorr was among the thousands of Imperial Academy cadets who were rapidly advanced into service,<ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> eventually achieving the rank of Captain.<ref name="CCG" />

[[File:Vaders_shuttle_pilots.png|thumb|right|Yorr and Jendon piloting Darth Vader's shuttle.]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Yorr and Jendon were the pilot and copilot respectively of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], [[ST 321/Legends|''ST 321'']], as it made its way to the Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Upon arriving at the [[Battle station/Legends|station]] the two made final readings and monitored the descent functions; a sequence they'd each performed a thousand times. Yorr requested clearance to land and transmitted the transmission code. The controller, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Jad Bean/Legends|Jad Bean]], responded, informing them that the shield would be deactivated when the code was confirmed. Biting the inside of his cheek and smiling nervously at Jendon, Yorr told him to hurry, stating that their passenger was in no mood to wait.<ref name="ROTJN" /> When the code was confirmed, Yorr and Jendon landed the shuttle onboard the space station.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Yorr was a Human male with [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a light skin complexion.<ref name="ROTJ" /> He was worried about how Vader might react while having to wait to land, and was afraid to look at the Dark Lord himself during the flight.<ref name="ROTJN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yorr made his first appearance in the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of Return of the Jedi. Yorr appeared in [[Richard Marquand]]'s [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], where he was portrayed by actor [[Jasper Jacob]]. Jasper spent two days filming his work during March 1982. Jasper had a hard time memorizing his dialog. This lead to them having to do many takes, but director Richard Marquand was very understanding. The scene Jasper appears in as Yorr was cut to only a few lines.<ref name="Jasper Jacob - Captain Yorr - Shuttle Pilot - ROTJ">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2012/03/archive-blog-star-wars-stars-at.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=Jasper Jacob - Captain Yorr - Shuttle Pilot - ROTJ}}</ref> The script for Return of the Jedi is featured on [[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]] where Yorr is mentioned.<ref name="Star Wars: Behind the Magic">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> He would also be featured in the [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|junior novel]] as well.
